title: lasiarrhenum trinervium
intro: Lasiarrhenum trinervium, commonly known as Korean angelica, is a plant species in the family Apiaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Lasiarrhenum trinervium include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-cancer properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of menopausal hot flashes, menstrual cramps, and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include coumarins, furanocoumarins, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
